not_covered.item: Review-period panels (Humanoid fall rules and time limits, Ant reset initialization and breadth, Evolution Gym timeouts): the bootstrap intervals of rho, the top-10 overlaps, the counts of bodies with negative reward, D and the 33-comparison adjustment, and the panel settings (trainers, budgets and timeouts). Their run counts, pools, seeds, hardware, wall times, rank correlations and seed-half references are recomputed here (panels.*)
not_covered.where: Raw records are not in the results directory (cluster storage). Their per-cell scores, specifications and frozen reports are in panels.zip of the dataset, and scripts/review_panels.py recomputes every statistic in those reports, including the intervals with the reports' seeds and the top-10 overlaps. D and the 33-comparison adjustment come from a separate analysis script that is not released.

not_covered.item: Structure appendix beyond in-sample fits: leave-one-out R^2 (M2 0.40, M1 0.07, height 0.37; on the 72 M1 0.08, M2 0.25, height 0.10), the leave-one-out Spearman rho of M2 (0.65) and its p-value, leave-one-family-out rho with intervals and held-out R^2 (M2 0.12, -0.25, 0.41; height 0.33, -0.06, 0.55; M2 on the 72 -0.17, -0.11, -0.60), the nine-fold crossfit (median rho 0.51 against 0.30; 8 of 9 folds on the 72) and the non-evolved transfer test (0.41 [0.18, 0.60] overall, 0.06 [-0.29, 0.38] within the evolved height range of 43 bodies)
not_covered.where: scripts/structural_feature_regression.py and the authors' independent verification scripts (not released).

not_covered.item: Other planned tests in the register: predicting worst-case reward (R^2 = 0.06), the rule x time-limit factorial (F(2,505) = 3.72, p = 0.025; median shifts -0.38 [-0.67, -0.18], -0.02 [-0.17, 0.16] and +0.05 [-0.13, 0.13]; rank correlations 0.71 and 0.94), contact-based termination (per-run p = 1.4e-4, rho = 0.19 [-0.18, 0.50]), the boundary-duration sweep (rho 0.92 [0.78, 0.97] and 0.85 [0.68, 0.94]; slope 0.099 [0.053, 0.150] per tenfold limit), existing-robots panel (2 of 4 robots passed the quality check)

SAC scale check and body choice: the check run on 8 bodies (the plan specified 1) that failed on 4 (Standard to Reset-free ratios 2.75 to 12.84 against a planned 0.5 to 2), its replacement by agreement with PPO (6 of 7 within a factor of 2), the 120 runs of the second batch, and the earlier mechanism study's choice of the 24 bodies (8 that fell often, 8 that barely moved, 8 unaffected)
not_covered.where: records/sac_full_panel_launch_log.md and records/sac_full_panel_spec.md (scale check, replacement and batches); scripts/mechanism_morphologies.txt lists the 24 bodies without their categories. The pilot statistics and the seed-averaged and permutation p-values are recomputed (sac.pilot.*, sac.*.seedmean_*, sac.*.perm_p).

not_covered.item: Fall rules in public code (DERL's ratio 0.5 and 0.2 m clearance with a limit bootstrapped at 1,000 steps; MetaMorph's 0.3; Transform2Act's 0.7 m, 20 and 60 degree limits and alive bonuses 1.0 and 0.1; BodyGen; Evolution Gym), the Gymnasium healthy ranges (Ant [0.2, 1.0] m below its 0.25 m torso radius, Hopper above 0.7 m, Walker2d [0.8, 2.0] m, Humanoid [1.0, 2.0] m, alive bonus 1.0 and 5.0) and their fractions of the initial torso height (0.27, 0.56, 0.64, 0.71), DERL budget facts, compute hardware of the UNIMAL panels, the source of the 100 bodies (MetaMorph's training set, chosen from the 300 bodies that DERL evolved, 100 in each of three environments) and the page of DERL's statement on early termination
not_covered.where: Source code and launch records, not run results: records/termination_rules_public_code.md (DERL, MetaMorph, Transform2Act, BodyGen, Evolution Gym) and the Gymnasium 1.0.0 MuJoCo environment files (healthy_z_range and initial torso heights of the v4 and v5 environments, not copied into the release). The body source is stated in MetaMorph (Gupta et al., ICLR 2022, Appendix A.2) and DERL (Gupta et al., Nature Communications 12, 5721, 2021, Methods).

not_covered.item: Training, evaluation and probe settings: the PPO preset (5M steps as 2,441 updates of 2,048 steps, 128 environments, 16 steps per rollout, minibatch 256, 10 epochs, learning rate 3e-4, discount 0.99, GAE 0.95, clip 0.2, value and entropy coefficients 0.5 and 0.01, gradient norm 0.5, two layers of 64 units, physics step 0.005 s, frame skip 4, control step 0.02 s), the reward and reset constants (action cost 0.001, reset noise 0.01, upper height bound max(3 z0, 2 m)), 20 evaluation episodes, the SAC settings (Brax 0.14.2, 128 environments, batch 256, learning rate 3e-4, discount 0.99, reward scaling 1, replay buffer 100,000 with a minimum of 1,280, two layers of 256 units, target rate 0.005), the probe designs (drops from 1 m, 20-episode probes, 300 random sequences per body in the smaller probe) and the quantities that follow from them (about 39,000 steps per environment; about 13 and 3 episodes per environment at limits of 3,001 and 10,001 steps), and the Stable-Baselines3 PPO defaults that the preset changes (minibatch 64, entropy coefficient 0)
